name: teammate-comms
description: Agent-to-agent messaging with idle wake for coding-agent sessions on one machine (Claude Code and Codex).

interface.shortDescription: Message other Claude Code / Codex sessions on this machine and get woken when they message you.
interface.longDescription: File-backed inboxes shared by every coding-agent session on the machine, plus a wake per harness: Claude Code sessions are woken over the plugin channel, Codex sessions via `codex queue` on their own thread. On Codex the plugin's session-start hook registers the MCP server with `codex mcp add` (restart Codex once after install) and hands the agent its thread id so it can register with harness_session.
